svg.title: nat-simulation
svg.desc: nat-simulation: see how a router hides its clients behind its own address. A packet leaves the client with source 192.168.1.10 and, via the router, arrives with source 203.0.113.1. Pieces in this set: 1x client (192.168.1.10), 1x router (203.0.113.1), 1x server (203.0.113.80).
